corrections.reason: In Classical Ge'ez, 'a man who sees his crowns' is 'ብእሲ ፡ ዘይሬኢ ፡ አክሊላቲሁ' (directly glossing the preceding Amharic 'ሹመቱን ፡ ሽልማቱን ፡ ያየ ፡ አርበኛ'). The fifth-order 'ሬ' was misread as 'ፈ' due to ink bleed on the lower right loop.
The printed glyph has the second-order (ካዕብ) right-side marker for 'ስኑ' ('his beauty increases upon beauty' in the passive/intransitive 'ይትዌሰክ ፡ ስኑ'), which was misread as 'ስነ'.
Both visually on the page and morphologically in Ge'ez (Wisdom 5:1, 'በብዙኅ ፡ ግህደት'), the sixth-order 'ህ' is printed rather than first-order 'ሀ'.
